[spoiler=[b]The war progresses[/b]]
As the situation in Astanir continues to spiral and escalate, several advances and losses have been made as the war continues into 2026.

[b]In the east - [nation]Qianxun[/nation][/b]
On the eastern side of the island, Democratic forces continue to make advances with the help of Qianxun and pax international. A successful offensive has brought more coastline under the control of Democratic forces, as well as securing the southern exclave. This further allowed democratic forces to split off the junta forces and begin an offensive against their trapped forces, as well as begin descending upon the surrounded nationalist-held city of Zasuro. 

Additionally, waves of men have been poured into the long northern frontlines, allowing the democratic forces to make a slow, attritional advance towards the main strongholds of the junta forces.

[b]Argossian advances - [nation]nordiheim[/nation][/b]
On the other side of the island, negotiations would go well between the argossians and nordiheimians. The three main tribes of the island had for the first time in a century worked together successfully. A push by all sides towards each other would result in the creation of a coherent territory for the argossian militias.

The next step would be to unite the various tribes under one government. Talks have begun, but are progressing slowly due to each tribe having their own distinct identity, yet still sharing a common enemy and a common goal.

Meawhile, on the lower islands the efforts of the Nordiheimian shadow keepers had payed off. Negotiations and persuasion had informed the tribes of the islands of the current situation and convinced them to stage an uprising. On the 1st January 2026, as new year celebrations commenced and the junties let their guard down, the Sulwik-Et-Hamanar tribe, using Nordiheimian intelligence and equipment, launched an offensive against several junta military bases, establishing a foothold on the lower island of akmazchi and dealing a horrible blow to the reputation and credibility of the junta.

[b]Southern discontent - [nation]pantagruel[/nation][/b]
On the amaralan islands, the people's army would make a major offensive against the junta, capturing the rest of the archipelago in under a day. They would begin preparing a naval task force for an invasion of the main island, feeling hopeful as negotiations with pantagruel prepared to go ahead. However, panic struck when an air attack began across the islands.

Initially, it was suspected to be an attack by Arenenge or another Amaralan power opposed to pantagruel, but upon examination using data from radars before they were destroyed, it shocked the faction to discover that they had just been attacked by Pantagruel itself.

The 40-year-old antiair equipment would be no match for Pantagruel's air superiority aircraft. Airbases and air defences would be decimated in minutes, giving the amaralans no time to react and respond. With imminent destruction coming their way, it would be made clear to the diplomats that peace had to be secured with Pantagruel...
[/spoiler]
